label: OpenCode: Environment Diagnostics
command: PATH="/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:$PATH"; [ -x ./qsbx ] && echo '[OK] qsbx wrapper found' || echo '[FAIL] qsbx wrapper not found'; command -v sbx >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo '[OK] sbx installed' || echo '[FAIL] sbx not found'; command -v opencode >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo '[OK] opencode installed' || echo '[FAIL] opencode not found'; sbx secret ls 2>/dev/null | grep -q 'api.gsa.usai.gov.*USAI_API_KEY' && echo '[OK] USAI_API_KEY custom secret set' || echo '[FAIL] USAI_API_KEY custom secret not found'
